```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Fetch live status from the rsrch server
status_data = d3.json("http://localhost:3030/system/status")

// Function to trigger refresh
refresh_system = async () => {
    const res = await fetch("http://localhost:3030/system/refresh", { method: "POST" });
    if (res.ok) {
        // Trigger a re-fetch of the status data
        // OJS will automatically update downstream cells
        location.reload(); 
    }
}
```

### Feature Matrix

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(status_data.features, {
  columns: ["name", "status", "pattern", "actions", "spec"],
  header: {
    name: "Feature",
    status: "Status",
    pattern: "Architecture",
    actions: "Actions",
    spec: "Specification"
  }
})
```

## Row {height=30%}

### System Architecture

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    CLI[CLI / API] --> Client[Client Orchestrator]
    Client --> Actions[Modular Actions]
    Actions --> Browser[Persistent Browser Context]
    
    subgraph "Stateless Handlers"
        Actions
    end
    
    subgraph "Stateful Layer"
        Browser
        Graph[FalkorDB Graph Store]
    end
    
    Actions -.-> Graph
```
